detected_relationships.name: Vitamin D & PTH Inverse Dynamic (Secondary Hyperparathyroidism)
detected_relationships.relationship_observation: Sub-optimal 25(OH)D impairs intestinal calcium absorption, triggering a compensatory increase in PTH secretion to mobilize skeletal calcium reserves.

explainability.explanation: 25(OH)D is required for enterocyte synthesis of calbindin-D9k and TRPV6 channels, governing 80-90% of dietary calcium absorption.

Metabolic bone turnover status directly dictates primary mechanical stability of cementless porous implants versus cemented fixations.
